reason: The build is feasible, but the value case fails. FEASIBILITY: the build is a one-line cell-0 edit (READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.98) that is byte-identical when off, with ~0 runtime cost. It fits a ~23 min dummy against ~7 GPU-h left. The lowrefine coupling is as described (tools/build_probe_kernel.py l.1650-1652: pool rows scoring >= BIOHUB_READMIT_MIN_SCORE are refined). VALUE fails on four points. (1) It is a closed line in disguise. Raising the threshold only deletes readmitted nodes: the ILP-discarded peaks in [0.965, 0.98). Readmits match GT at 0.5% (73/13,284), so the only channel is the node-count term. That is exactly the leaf-prune channel on x138: 479 of 513 pruned leaves were readmits (CONTEXT l.1515), and 95% of the lp30 removals (I-277). That channel read PUBLIC 0 (P36 - #35 = 0, CONTEXT l.2295, lab +0.0008; probe 27 was also 0). 'Leaf prune on x138' is on the closed list, and I-277 (DC readmit veto) was refuted as 'leaf prune in disguise'. Keying the drop by score instead of leaf status changes which readmits go, not the channel. (2) The value is not disclosed. Discussion 743929 disclosed only the LOWERED value (0.965 -> 0.94, +0.001); JT's 'two arms' is generic process advice. 0.98 is our own extrapolation, so aggressive mode does not make it actionable, and W4 AMEND 2 (4) bans knob rungs. The R24S-5 exception that would admit it was written by the same scan, which is circular. (3) The LB anchors contradict each other and the mechanism is asymmetric. The old anchor 'readmit -0.001' (frontier947 -> frontier947-readmit) favours fewer readmits, while JT favours more. [0.94, 0.965) holds sub-threshold peaks, while [0.965, 0.98) holds above-threshold detections, so a '-' at 0.94 does not imply '+' at 0.98. The finding's own numbers are EV ~0 +- 0.001 and P('+') 0.15-0.3 on a 0.001 display grid. The count of readmits in the band is unmeasured (exp70g dummy 1,365 readmits in total), and so is the node range (-0.1..-1.1%). (4) PRIVATE: it acts only through the node term. Node levers have flipped sign by embryo (44b6 -0.0023 vs 6bba +0.0008, I-139 r17). A '+' display would be a winner's-curse knob read entering V_pub. It would take the W2b slot (under R-) or a W4 slot (under R0/R?/R-) from SEC, CI or DIV reads, or from the E10 hold, which carry more information.
fix: Do not give RA98 a W2b row, and do not put it in W4 (d)-(f). Delete the RA98 lookup row and its READMIT 0.98 stop-rule clause from R24S-2/R24S-3. Under R- the READMIT line simply closes at 0.965 (the base already sits there). The W2b row for R- then falls to exp81 (SEC) or the existing W2 v4 fallbacks. Building exp87f/g/h is CPU-only and harmless, so they may stay as unpushed files. No dummy is pushed unless a W4 slot would otherwise go unused after E10 / FULL / '?' levers / exp84a, and then only as a logged filler with the pre-registered note 'leaf-prune channel, P36 = 0 prior'.
realistic_gain: ~0 on public (most likely display code '0', as the leaf-prune channel read P36 - #35 = 0); at most +0.0005 unrounded; a private sign that is unknown and embryo-dependent; costs one 28/29 Sep slot.
